The '''''Exemplar''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] and the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Gravus]] at the [[Second battle of Leritor]]. It was destroyed by the ''[[Ascendant Spear]]''.
